compare.description: Compare mode: pass an OBJECT with optional 'mutations' (list of {op, field, value}) and 'credential' (string name). NOT a boolean.

credential.description: Named credential to apply (see web_session for available credentials)

unauthenticated.description: Strip all auth headers (true = unauthenticated baseline)

follow_redirects.description: Follow 3xx redirects (default false — redirect Location is the evidence)
